svg.aria-label: Measured LDPE-in-soil spectrum distributed with OpenSpecy (CC BY 4.0), replotted here. The ordinate preserves the original response values. Shading guides attention to C–H stretching and methylene bending/rocking regions. The enlarged region and residuals show how smoothing changes band shape.
